question: What callback URL should I allowlist in my OAuth provider when setting up authentication for Fern Docs?
ground_truth: You should allowlist the callback URL `https://<your-domain>/api/fern-docs/oauth2/callback`, replacing `<your-domain>` with your actual Fern Docs domain. If you want to authenticate both your `.docs.buildwithfern.com` subdomain and a custom domain, you'll need to allowlist both callback URLs.
